identifiability.basis: demonstrations only; finite declared rivals, not universal uniqueness

program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g) ((lambda (g)
         (let* ((greens (find-color g 3))
                (bb (bbox-of-cells greens))
                (gr1 (first bb))
                (gc1 (second bb))
                (gr2 (third bb))
                (gc2 (fourth bb))
                (markers (filter (lambda (p)
                                   (and
                                     (!= (first p) gr1)
                                     (!= (first p) gr2)
                                     (!= (second p) gc1)
                                     (!= (second p) gc2)))
                                 greens))
                (mr (first (first markers)))
                (mc (second (first markers))))
           (cellmap g
                    (r c v)
                    (if (= v 3)
                        3
                        (if (and (> r gr1) (< r gr2) (> c gc1) (< c gc2) (zero? v))
                            (let ((d (+ (abs (- r mr)) (abs (- c mc)))))
                              (if (zero? (modulo d 2)) 2 4))
                            v))))) ((lambda (g)
      (let* ((greens (find-color g 3)) (bb (bbox-of-cells greens))
             (gr1 (first bb)) (gc1 (second bb)) (gr2 (third bb)) (gc2 (fourth bb))
             (markers (filter (lambda (p) (and (> (first p) gr1) (< (first p) gr2)
                        (> (second p) gc1) (< (second p) gc2))) greens))
             (mr (first (first markers))) (mc (second (first markers)))
             (north (- mr gr1)) (south (- gr2 mr)) (west (- mc gc1)) (east (- gc2 mc))
             (nearest (min north south west east)) (farthest (max north south west east))
             (vertical (or (= nearest north) (= nearest south)))
             (nr (if vertical (- (+ gr1 gr2) mr) mr)) (nc (if vertical mc (- (+ gc1 gc2) mc))))
        (cellmap g (r c v)
          (cond ((and (= r nr) (= c nc)) 3)
                ((and (= r mr) (= c mc)) 0) (else v))))) g))))
